error.range: This number is outside the allowed range.
error.slot: Invalid time slot on {day}: enter a start and end time; the end must be after the start.
error.slots_required: Add at least one time slot for a custom weekly schedule.
error.not_found: This page does not exist (any more).
login.title: Log in
login.no_admin: There is no administrator yet. Create one on the server, as root:
login.no_admin_docker: If Wisselweer runs in Docker, use this on the host instead:
dashboard.title: Your vehicles
dashboard.empty_text: Add your first vehicle to see when it is sensible to switch tyres.
dashboard.add_set_hint: Add a tyre set and mount it to get advice.
dashboard.advice_failed: The advice could not be calculated right now. Try again later.
advice.no_reliable_date: No reliable change date available yet.
advice.plan_asap: Book an appointment as soon as possible
advice.plan_self_asap: Plan the tyre change as soon as possible
advice.horizon_until: The weather forecast was used up to and including {date}.
advice.horizon_provider: Source: {name}, forecast up to about {days} days ahead.
vehicle.delete_warning: This will also remove all tyre sets, changes, odometer readings and appointments for this vehicle. This cannot be undone.
vehicle.name: Name
vehicle.why_personal: This advice is for this car: its own location, your driving times and the lead time of your changeover method. The national advice (as on wisselweer.nl) looks at several places during rush hours and weekends, without lead time, so it can differ.
vehicle.no_horizon: There is no usable weather forecast.
location.label: Location
location.name: Place name or description
location.coords_help: You can also enter them yourself: find the place in a map app such as OpenStreetMap, right-click the map and choose to copy the coordinates (or press and hold the spot on your phone). Enter the latitude first (around 52 in the Netherlands), then the longitude (around 5). A full stop or a comma both work.
profile.label: Driving profile
profile.intro: The advice weighs the temperature at the times you actually drive.
profile.commute: Commuting (Mon-Fri, morning and evening rush hour)
profile.schedule_help: Only used with 'Custom weekly schedule'. Enter a start and end time for each day; leave a slot empty to skip it.
method.label: Change method
method.prep_days_help: How many days in advance you want to know that a change is needed. With a garage, that garage's lead time counts.
tire.size_help: Printed on the sidewall of the tyre, for example 205/55 R16 91H: width in mm, height as a percentage of the width, rim diameter in inches, load index and speed rating.
tire.dot_help: The last four digits of the DOT code are the week and year of manufacture: 2319 is week 23 of 2019.
tire.km_incomplete: incomplete, not known for all periods
tread.help: Tread depth (optional): enter the date and the depth in mm per wheel.
change.odometer_help: Optional, but needed to be able to calculate kilometres per set.
change.no_sets: There is no stored tyre set to change to. Add a set first.
odometer.title: Odometer readings
appointment.title: Appointments
appointment.request_hint: Choose a preferred garage with an email address (under Change method) to be able to request an appointment by email here.
garage.name: Name
garage.email_help: Needed for the 'Request appointment' button. Nothing is sent by the app itself; it only opens your own email program.
garage.lead_time_help: How many days ahead you usually have to book an appointment.
settings.provider_unavailable: This weather source is not available or not configured.
settings.no_locations: No locations yet; they are created when you add a vehicle.
settings.tokens_help: Tokens give access to the API, for example for Home Assistant. A token is shown only once.
settings.token_once: Copy this token now and keep it safe. It will never be shown again.
compare.title: Diagnostic model comparison
compare.label: For comparison only, not combined: advice always uses a single source.
compare.no_data: No weather data available to compare.
provider.missing_contact: Set WISSELWEER_CONTACT (a contact address or URL); MET Norway requires it.
provider.openmeteo_noncommercial: The free Open-Meteo host may not be used commercially; use your own host or an API key.
provider.knmi_forecast_not_available: KNMI model data is not yet available in this version.
provider.missing_credentials: API key is missing; set it via the environment.
public.summary.KEEP_CURRENT.winter: In the reference regions, the summer tyres can stay on for now.
public.summary.KEEP_CURRENT.summer: In the reference regions, the winter tyres can stay on for now.
public.summary.PREPARE_CHANGE.winter: The forecast points to an approaching turning point: prepare the change to winter tyres.
public.summary.PREPARE_CHANGE.summer: The forecast points to an approaching turning point: prepare the change to summer tyres.
public.summary.CHANGE_RECOMMENDED.winter: According to the forecast, it is time for winter tyres in the reference regions.
public.summary.CHANGE_RECOMMENDED.summer: According to the forecast, it is time for summer tyres in the reference regions.
public.summary.REGIONAL_DIFFERENCES: Conditions differ by region. There is no single nationwide change moment yet.
public.summary.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: At the moment there is too little weather data for reliable nationwide advice.
public.warning_note: It may be slippery locally; heed the KNMI warnings.
geo.privacy: What you type here is only sent to the geocoder when you search and is not stored. Only the rounded coordinates end up in your location.
geo.short: Type at least 2 characters to search.
geo.none: No results found. Try a different spelling or enter the coordinates yourself.
geo.found: Choose a result from the list.
geo.filled: Coordinates filled in. Check them and save.
geo.busy: Too many searches in a short time. Try again in a few seconds.
geo.error: Searching is not working right now. Try again later or enter the coordinates yourself.
geo.located: Your location has been filled in, rounded to about 100 metres.
geo.denied: Access to your location was denied. Search for an address or enter the coordinates yourself.
geo.unavailable: Your location could not be determined. Search for an address or enter the coordinates yourself.
geo.insecure: Getting your location only works over a secure connection (https).
tire.size_odd: This does not look like a common tyre size (such as 205/55 R16 91H). You can still save it.
tire.groups_help: By default, one line for all the tyres in the set. Has a tyre been replaced or is it different? Then add a separate line. At most 4 tyres in total.
tire.positions_help: Optional: FL, FR, RL and/or RR (front or rear, left or right), separated by a comma.
tire.replace_intro: Enter the new tyres. The old tyres are kept in the history of the set.
tire.replace_quantity_help: If you replace only some of the tyres in a line, the line is split in two.
tire.age_unknown: Unknown: the DOT code is missing or cannot be read.
tire.age_warn: Tyres age even without wear. From {years} years, a check or replacement is advisable.
tire.count_warn: Note: {count} tyres are registered instead of 4.
tire.pmsf: 3PMSF symbol (mountain with snowflake) on the tyre
tire.pmsf_help: Tyres with this symbol meet the stricter winter standard; the old M+S marking alone is no longer enough in Germany and France, among others.
tire.pmsf_not_all: Not all tyres have the 3PMSF symbol.
photo.title: Photo
photo.help: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB. On a phone you can take a photo or pick one from your library. Location data (EXIF) is removed.
photo.delete_confirm: Delete the photo of this vehicle?
photo.ready: Ready to upload (resized, without location data).
photo.failed: Resizing failed; the original file will be sent and checked by the server.
photo.error.too_large: The photo is too large (2 MB at most). Choose a smaller photo.
photo.error.unsupported: This file type is not supported. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
photo.error.corrupt: The photo is damaged or incomplete. Choose another photo.
photo.error.store: The photo could not be saved; check the permissions on the data folder.
login.rate_limited: Too many failed attempts; try again later
error.conflict: This data conflicts with existing data, for example a duplicate name.
err.mounted_exists: A set is already mounted. Use a tyre change to switch.
err.set_min_tires: A set has at least one tyre.
err.set_max_tires: A set has at most {max} tyres.
err.mount_via_change: Mounting is done through a tyre change.
err.mounted_no_delete: A mounted set cannot be deleted.
err.set_in_history: This set is in the change history and cannot be deleted. Set its status to retired.
err.group_replaced_locked: Replaced tyres can no longer be edited.
err.set_min_group: A set keeps at least one active line of tyres.
err.group_already_replaced: These tyres have already been replaced.
err.replace_too_many: You cannot replace more tyres than the line contains.
err.replace_future: The replacement date is in the future.
err.odometer_cycle: The corrections of this odometer reading refer to each other.
err.odometer_inconsistent: This odometer reading does not fit the existing readings.
err.odometer_negative: The odometer reading cannot be negative.
err.odometer_corrected: This reading has already been corrected. Correct the valid reading.
err.set_wrong_vehicle: This tyre set does not belong to this vehicle.
err.retired_no_mount: A retired set cannot be mounted.
err.change_future: The change date is in the future.
err.garage_has_appointments: This garage has appointments and cannot be deleted.
err.period_order: The end of the period is before the start.
err.confirmed_needs_time: A confirmed appointment needs a time.
err.garage_no_email: This garage has no email address.
err.transition_not_allowed: This status change is not allowed.
err.name_length: The name must be 1 to 80 characters long.
err.token_exists: An active token with this name already exists.
err.token_missing: There is no active token with this name.

mail.intro.to_summer: I would like to book an appointment to change from winter to summer tyres.
mail.intro.none: I would like to book an appointment for a tyre change.
mail.ask: Could you let me know which times are available?
rdw.privacy: Only when you click this is the number plate sent to RDW Open Data (Dutch plates only). Make, model and year are filled in; you can still change them.
rdw.filled: Make, model and year filled in from the RDW data. Please check them.
rdw.invalid: Enter a Dutch number plate first, for example AB-123-C.
rdw.not_found: No vehicle found for this number plate.
rdw.error: The RDW cannot be reached right now. Fill in the details yourself or try again later.
rdw.no_recall: No open recall known to the RDW.
rdw.recall_unknown: According to the RDW there is an open recall for this vehicle.
rdw.recall_advice: Contact your brand dealer to schedule the repair.
ical.to_winter: Change to winter (or all-season) tyres. Advice from Wisselweer; check the current advice in the app.
ical.to_summer: Change to summer tyres. Advice from Wisselweer; check the current advice in the app.
heading.to_winter.keep_current: Summer tyres can stay on for now
heading.to_winter.prepare_change: Prepare the switch to winter tyres
heading.to_summer.keep_current: Winter tyres can stay on for now
heading.to_summer.prepare_change: Prepare the switch to summer tyres
reason.cold_streak: From {start}, {days} cold days in a row are expected (below {threshold} °C).
reason.persistent_frost: From {start}, persistent frost is expected ({days} days).
reason.persistent_snow: From {start}, persistent snow is expected ({days} days).
reason.trend_only: The turning point is more than a week away; only a period, not a date.
reason.no_sustained_cold: No sustained cold in the forecast.
reason.winter_season_not_open: It is outside the winter tyre season.
reason.summer_season_not_open: It is still too early in the year for summer tyres.
reason.frost_in_horizon: There is still frost or snow in the forecast (first day {first_day}).
reason.warm_streak: From {start}, {days} warm days in a row are expected ({threshold} °C or higher).
reason.warm_spell_too_short: The warm spell is too short to justify summer tyres.
reason.not_warm_enough: It is not yet getting consistently warm enough.
reason.drive_window_fallback: For {days} day(s) without a driving time, the daily average was used.
reason.drive_window_used: Temperatures are weighted by your driving times.
reason.appointment_urgent: Plan as soon as possible: the preferred preparation time has already passed.
reason.all_season_warnings_only: All-season tyres: warnings only, no change advice.
reason.no_mounted_set: No mounted tyre set is known.
reason.forecast_too_old: The weather forecast is too old to rely on.
reason.insufficient_hours: The weather forecast contains too few usable hours.
reason.status_held: Advice not changed yet: waiting for confirmation ({streak} of {needed}).
uncertainty.beyond_horizon: The weather forecast does not reach far enough to confirm the turning point.
uncertainty.missing_variable: Not provided by the weather source: {variable}.
uncertainty.forecast_stale: The weather forecast is not fresh; the advice may change.
warning.frost.summer_tires: Frost possible: be careful, you are driving on summer tyres.
warning.snow.summer_tires: Snow possible: summer tyres are not suitable for this.
warning.icy.summer_tires: Risk of icy roads: be careful, you are driving on summer tyres.
warning.forecast_stale: The weather forecast is out of date.
